newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - October 9.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - October 9.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Wednesday. Reuter has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Unleaded premium petrol to rise by T$1 per litre.
Council of Agriculture to crack down on prohibited hillside farming.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - China Petroleum Corp proposes six percent petrol price hike.
Resubmitted nuclear plant bill passes first reading in legislature.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Kaohsiung bank reshuffle affects 72 managers.
Toyota slows investment in Taoyuan plant.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Prices of gasoline, diesel to rise.
Proposal for streamlined business tax targets 1998 fiscal year.
